title: NTSB and FAA Launch Probe into Marine One Near-Miss with Passenger Jet
summary: The NTSB and FAA are investigating why airport traffic continued when Marine One departed with President Trump, nearly colliding with a passenger plane on August 4. The agencies confirmed the air traffic controller maintained communication with both aircraft during the incident. Officials say the president was never in danger, but the incident raises concerns over aviation safety in Washington's crowded airspace.
summary_points: Marine One departed from Reagan Airport on August 4 without clearing airport traffic.
The NTSB and FAA are investigating why airport traffic continued during the departure.
Air traffic controller maintained communication with both Marine One and the passenger plane during the incident.
The president was never in danger, officials say, but the incident raises concerns over aviation safety.
